current_date: 2026 (titled 'OPDC Validation Checklist 2026'; no adoption date in the PDF; draft approved for consultation 19 March 2026 with adoption delegated to the Director of Planning; consultation summary report dated July 2026)
current_evidence: london.gov.uk's OPDC 'adopted-validation-checklist' page now redirects (302) to oldoakandparkroyal.co.uk/planning/planning-applications/local-validation-requirements, which links 'OPDC Validation Checklist 2026' alongside the July 2026 consultation summary report.

issues.detail: The linked file is not a GLA list. It is the Old Oak and Park Royal Development Corporation (OPDC) 'Draft Validation Checklist for Planning Applications', a consultation draft dated 16 September 2015, not an adopted list. The GLA itself does not run a local validation list. The validation authority behind this row is OPDC (a Mayoral Development Corporation), so the row should be named and scoped as OPDC.
issues.evidence: Document title 'Draft Validation Checklist for Planning Applications', issued by OPDC; consultation ran '16 September to 28 October 2015'; OPDC 'will consider comments before publishing the final checklist'.

issues.detail: The current list is the OPDC Validation Checklist 2026, on OPDC's own site. The 2015 draft has been superseded (it is two versions old, as an adopted checklist followed it).
issues.evidence: OPDC Local Validation Requirements page links 'OPDC Validation Checklist 2026 (PDF, 550.02 KB)'; OPDC Planning Committee 19 March 2026 'Approved the 2026 Draft Local Validation Checklist for a 6-week consultation period' and delegated adoption.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured essentially no requirements (1 item). The current 2026 OPDC list has 49 local requirements, including: Accommodation Schedule (major); Affordable Housing Statement (10+ homes); Affordable Workspace Management Strategy (new employment floorspace); Air Quality Assessment (major, polluting uses, sensitive uses near sources); Archaeological DBA; Biodiversity/Ecology (major, in or next to a SINC/LNR); BREEAM pre-assessment (non-residential units or extensions of 100 sqm or more); Circular Economy Statement incl. WLC (referable to the Mayor); CIL information (100 sqm+ or 1+ dwellings); Construction Management Plan; Contamination PRA; Daylight/Sunlight (major); Delivery and Servicing Plan; Design Code (outline/hybrid); Digital 3D model (referable); Energy Statement incl. overheating (major); Financial Viability Appraisal; Fire Statement (major); FRA (FZ2/3, basements, majors in Critical Drainage Areas); Health Impact Assessment (major); Heritage Statement; Landscape Strategy; Marketing Strategy (loss of employment/town centre/social infrastructure/pubs); Microclimate assessment (over 30m); Noise and Vibration; Open Space Assessment; Parking Design and Management Plan; Photomontages/CGIs (major); Heads of Terms; Planning Statement (all minor and major); PBSA need study; Residential Management Plan (PBSA, co-living, BTR, supported housing); s73/s96a information; Site Waste Management Plan (major); SCI (major); SuDS/water efficiency; Tall Building Statement (over 15 storeys or 48m); Telecommunications; Town Centre Uses Statement; TVIA; Transport Statement/Assessment; Travel Plan; Tree Assessment; Urban Greening Factor (major).
issues.evidence: OPDC Validation Checklist 2026, Part 2 Local requirements, items 1-49.

issues.detail: Both tab items are process or national-drawing text, not local requirements: one is a run-on of national drawing/site-area guidance ('When required In all cases For all FULL, OUTLINE and VARIATION...'); the other is submission instructions (Planning Portal, one hard copy plus CD/USB). The only Full planning row, 'Pre-application advice / engagement details', just encourages pre-app discussion for majors; it is not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'When applications are submitted in hard copy, only 1 copy should be provided but an electronic set of all the documents should also be submitted on CD or USB.'

issues.detail: Every application type except Full planning shows '(none)', but the OPDC list sets requirements for specific types: Design Code for all outline/hybrid applications (Outline), Sections 73 and 96a information (Variation of condition s73 / Non-material amendment), Advertisement Consent drawings (Advertisement consent), Telecommunications (prior approval/full), and Householder-relevant items such as Heritage Statement, FRA for basement extensions, Noise (air conditioning/plant) and Tree Assessment.
issues.evidence: OPDC Validation Checklist 2026: '18 Design Code - all outline or hybrid applications'; '38 Sections 73 and 96a Applications - any s73 or s96a application'.

summary: The GLA row actually points at OPDC's superseded 2015 consultation-draft checklist, not a GLA list. The current list is the OPDC Validation Checklist 2026 (49 local requirements), and Grokbot captured almost none of it.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The list date 2015-09-01 comes from PDF metadata. The document text dates it 16 September 2015 (start of consultation). Either way it is a draft, not an adoption date.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Draft consultation period '16 September to 28 October 2015'.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: 2015-09-01 matches the document's 16 September 2015 date at the workbook's month-precision convention. The valid point is that this is a draft consultation date, which the superseded-document rows (1076/1077) already cover.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error. The draft status is already covered elsewhere.
